# Copilot Instructions - Brunella Agent System (BAS)

Use `README.md` as the master guide. Keep this file compact and aligned with the live codebase. Path-specific rules live in `.github/instructions/` for `test/**` and `myai/**`.

## Session bootstrap

1. Sync first:
   - `scripts\sync.bat`
   - `.\scripts\sync.ps1`
   - `bash scripts/sync.sh`
2. Read:
   - `.ai/BOOTSTRAP.md`
   - `conductor/tracks.md`
   - `.ai/FOSZAL.md`
   - `.ai/copilot.md`
3. If the task belongs to an active track, also read `conductor/tracks/<id>/meta.json`, `plan.md`, and `spec.md` when present.
4. `FOSZAL.md` is generated by `python scripts/sync_foszal.py`; update `.ai/copilot.md` and re-sync instead of editing it directly.

## Build, test, and lint

| Command | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build` | TypeScript build plus registry/TRIZ copy |
| `npm run build:ui` | Dashboard build |
| `npm run build:stable` | Node build + dashboard build |
| `npm run dev` | Node/Express + MCP stdio |
| `npm run dev:ui` | Vite dashboard |
| `dashboard.bat` | Full Windows launch |
| `start-full.bat` | Full Windows stack (backend, Python, dashboard) |
| `npm run smoke` | Startup/health check |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint check |
| `npm run lint:fix` | ESLint autofix |
| `npm run test:fast` | Fast pre-push suite |
| `npm test` | Build + full Vitest suite |
| `npx vitest run test/foo.test.ts` | Single test file |
| `npm run test:dashboard` | Dashboard tests |
| `npm run test:ui` | UI tests |
| `npm run test:e2e` | Playwright e2e |
| `cd myai && uv sync` | Install Python deps |
| `cd myai && uvicorn server:app --reload --port 8000` | Start Python API |
| `cd myai && pytest tests/` | Run Python tests |
| `cd myai && pytest tests/test_foo.py` | Run one Python test file |

## High-level architecture

- `src/` is the Node control plane: Express API, MCP server, dashboard backend, CLI bridge.
- `myai/` is the Python subsystem: FastAPI on `:8000`, FastMCP, browser/RAG/ML helpers.
- `src/index.ts` starts the web server first and defers heavy imports to avoid startup OOM.
- `src/server/routes/index.ts` is the central lazy-loaded mount table for `/api/v1`; add new HTTP routes there.
- `src/server/registry.ts` captures MCP tool handlers and schemas for both local execution and discovery.
- `src/agents/registry.json` is the canonical TypeScript agent registry; `myai/agents/*.toml` are dynamic agents.
- `src/core/conductor.ts` owns the 8-stage kernel pipeline and reports progress to the Copilot orchestrator bridge.
- `src/core/autonomousInfraRuntime.ts` owns the `copilotFeedbackChannel` singleton; do not create a second instance.
- `src/core/modelRouter.ts` and `src/core/bifrost_gateway.ts` handle local/cloud routing and provider fallback.
- `src/core/hookRegistry.ts` and `src/core/hooks/*` own cross-service automation.
- `src/dashboard/lib/navigation.tsx` and `src/cli.ts` are parallel product surfaces; user-facing features usually need both.
- `conductor/tracks/*` is the source of truth for scoped work and track closure.
- `mcp_servers.json` drives MCP auto-start; keep server startup declarative.
- Copilot self-improvement flows through `src/core/autonomousInfraRuntime.ts` and `.github/workflows/self-improve.yml`; use `bas-self-reflect`, `bas-golden-dataset-enricher`, and `bas-pattern-scout` when that loop is in scope.

## Key conventions

- ESM relative imports must include `.js`.
- Avoid `any`; prefer `unknown` plus type guards.
- Avoid `console.log`; use `logInfo`, `logError`, `logWarn`, or `Logger`.
- If you implement `IAgent` directly, reset status in `finally`; `BaseAgent` already handles this.
- Vitest only: `vi.*` APIs, `fileParallelism: false`, 15s default timeout, no Jest.
- For `test/**`, follow `.github/instructions/test-conventions.instructions.md`.
- For `myai/**`, follow `.github/instructions/python-conventions.instructions.md`.
- Python uses `uv`, Pydantic models, and ASCII log prefixes on Windows.
- CLI UX is Hungarian and menu-driven (`Inquirer` + `Chalk` + `Boxen` + `Ora`).
- Track closure is evidence-based: no `--no-verify`; `completed` / `archived` require a valid DoD plus verification notes or archive reason.
- `progress: 100` is only valid after real build/test/commit evidence exists.
- `FOSZAL.md` is generated; update `.ai/copilot.md` and re-run `python scripts/sync_foszal.py`.
- Use specialized agents in `.github/agents/` when the task matches their domain, especially `bas-orchestrator-commander`, `bas-lead-developer`, `robust-test-writer`, `strict-code-reviewer`, `devops-infra-guardian`, and `sdlc-pipeline`.

## Common pitfall

- If `better-sqlite3` native bindings fail after a Node upgrade, rebuild them with `npm rebuild better-sqlite3`.
